newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mei Ah proposes share split, bonus issues.
newsitem.headline: Mei Ah proposes share split, bonus issues.

text.p: Mei Ah International Ltd said it proposed a share split of one-into-five, a bonus issue of two subdivided shares for every subdivided share, and a bonus issue of one warrant for every five subdivided shares held.
The movie video distributor said the share subdivision would enhance the liqudity of the company's shares in the market while the issued and paid up-capital would remain unchanged.
Mei Ah said it proposed to subdivide every company share of HK$0.10 each into five shares of HK$0.02 each.
Based on the 297,385,843 shares in issue as on January 30, there will be 1,486,929,210 subdivided shares in issue following the share split, it said.
The company also proposed a bonus shares issue of two bonus subdivided shares for every subdivided share held.
It also proposed a bonus warrant issue on the basis of one warrant for every five subdivided shares held.
Each bonus warrant will entitle to holders the right to subscribe for one new subdivided share at HK$0.20 each subject to adjustment between July 3, 1997, and December 31, 1998.
The share subdivision, the bonus share issue and bonus warrant issue are all inter-conditional, the company said.
The register of members will be closed from March 4 to 10.
Mei Ah shares rose HK$0.425 or 9.83 percent to HK$4.75 per share on early Friday morning.
